overview.description: The Zacks Preferred Income ETF (PRIZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is actively managed and aims to provide current income, targeting 8% annual distributions, through investing in preferred securities. The fund has the flexibility to invest globally in high-yield preferreds, rated below Ba1 or BB+. PRIZ was launched on May 28, 2026 and is issued by Zacks.
